tileHint.counting: Counts whose lines are being counted now.
tileHint.waiting: Submitted over the approval limit: a person who did not count them approves.
tileHint.toApply: Approved, or under the limit: their differences wait to be posted.
tileHint.yearEnd: Year-end inventories not signed off yet (art. 2217 c.c.).

list.emptyBody: Start a cycle count of a shelf or a material, or the year-end physical inventory of a site.
list.waitsApply: Under the limit: ready to apply
list.foot: Counts are per site and location; no person is named in this list. Values need cost access.
list.footCost: Counts are per site and location; no person is named in this list. Values are at cost (lot cost, else standard cost).

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.enterDown: Save the count and go to the next line
keys.escape: Put the cell back as it was
keys.undo: Take the last typed count back

new.title: New count
new.cycleHint: A shelf, a zone or a material, counted now; its expected quantities are frozen when it starts.
new.yearEndHint: The physical inventory as of 31 December of a year, for the inventory book (art. 2217 c.c.).
new.inventoryDateHint: The last day of the fiscal year: the stock is taken as of the end of that day.
new.teamHint: Who counts, as a team name (no person is named in the lists).
new.scopeHint: Leave everything empty to count the whole site. Each choice narrows the count.
new.locationHint: A location and everything under it.
new.materialHint: Type at least 2 letters of its code or name: materials and finished garments.
new.noMaterials: Your role may not search materials: the count covers every material.
new.materialSearch: Find a material or a garment
new.lotHint: One lot of the material, or all of them.
new.startHint: The expected quantities are frozen now and the lines are made; off, the count stays a draft.
new.startLater: A year-end inventory starts on {date} or after it: it is made as a draft now.
new.footDraft: The count is made as a draft.
new.yearEndLaw: The year-end inventory counts the stock as of {date}; once signed off, its valued list is frozen and kept for 10 years (art. 2217 and 2220 c.c.).

held.noApprove: Your role may not approve counts (inventory.counts.approve).
held.noAdjust: Posting the differences needs stock corrections (inventory.adjust).
held.noCostSignOff: The valued list is a cost document: signing it off needs cost access.
held.noCostPreview: The valued list shows costs: it needs cost access.
held.noFiles: Your role may not open stored files (files.read).
held.notCounting: Only a count that is counting is submitted.
held.notSubmitted: It is approved once it is submitted.
held.notApproved: It is applied once it is approved.
held.approveFirst: Over the approval limit: approve the differences first.
held.waitingApprover: Waiting for approval by the warehouse manager (a person who did not count the differences).
held.ownVariance: You counted or recounted lines that differ: another person approves them.
held.notYearEnd: Only a year-end inventory is signed off.
held.signedOff: Signed off already: its valued list is frozen.
held.notApplied: It is signed off once its differences are applied.
held.notEditable: Only a draft or a count that is counting changes its team or note.
held.notNow: Not possible in its present state.
held.startFirst: Start the count first: its lines are made when it starts.
held.linesClosed: The lines are history once the count is submitted.
held.posted: Its differences are posted: reverse a move in Movements instead.
held.reasonFirst: Write the reason first (at least 3 characters).
held.reasonDetail: This reason asks for a note.
held.tooEarly: A year-end inventory starts on {date} or after it.
held.uncounted_one: {count} line is not counted yet: type 0 for what was not found.
held.uncounted_other: {count} lines are not counted yet: type 0 for what was not found.
held.recountsDue_one: {count} recount asked for is not done yet.
held.recountsDue_other: {count} recounts asked for are not done yet.
held.unreasoned_one: {count} line that differs has no reason yet (Differences).
held.unreasoned_other: {count} lines that differ have no reason yet (Differences).

record.name: Count
record.title: Count {number}
record.notFoundBody: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company or site.
record.sentBackBanner: Sent back by {name} on {date}: count the lines again
record.moved_one: Stock moved at {count} line since the snapshot
record.moved_other: Stock moved at {count} lines since the snapshot
record.movedBody: Nothing is frozen until W2b: a move after the snapshot is not in the expected quantity. Count what is there and say why it differs.
record.draftCycle: Start counting to freeze the expected quantities and make the lines.
record.draftYearEnd: It starts on {date} or after it; the expected quantities are the stock at the end of that day.
record.noPanels: The thread, files and history of this count open here.
record.noThreads: The thread of a count needs the right to read threads (threads.read).

lines.draftBody: The lines are made when the count starts (the expected quantities frozen).
lines.emptyBody: Nothing was in stock here at the snapshot. Add what you find with "Found stock".
lines.howTo: Type what you count: Enter saves and goes down, 0 means not found, Esc puts the cell back, ⌘Z takes the last count back.
lines.failed_one: {count} line was not saved: see its state.
lines.failed_other: {count} lines were not saved: see their state.
lines.undoHint: ⌘Z takes back the count of line {seq}.

line.moved: Stock moved here since the snapshot

problem.number: Type a number (0 for not found).
problem.hideArea: A hide is counted by its area: no more than it measured.
problem.recountBack: A recount is not taken back: type it again.

diff.noneBody: Everything counted agrees with what was expected.
diff.noneYet_one: None so far: {count} line is not counted yet.
diff.noneYet_other: None so far: {count} lines are not counted yet.
diff.noCostTitle: No lot cost and no standard cost: its value is unknown, so the count needs an approval.
diff.needReasons_one: {count} line that differs has no reason: submitting needs one per line.
diff.needReasons_other: {count} lines that differ have no reason: submitting needs one per line.
diff.costHidden: Values are at cost and need cost access: they are not shown to your role.

select.closed: The lines change only while the count is counting.
select.uncounted: A line not counted yet is not recounted.

check.applied: Applied: one COUNT move per difference
check.signedOff: Signed off: the valued list frozen

approval.withApply: Under the limit: approved with the apply by {name}
approval.notNeeded: Under the limit: no second person needed
approval.waiting: Waiting for approval by the warehouse manager
approval.youMay: You may approve: you counted none of the lines that differ.
approval.applyWhat: Posts one COUNT move per difference, dated at the snapshot.
approval.signOffWhat: Freezes the valued list as of the inventory date (PDF and XLSX).
approval.requiredYes: Yes: over the limit, or a value is unknown
approval.reversal: A posted difference is reversed move by move in Movements.
approval.valueNow: Value of the differences so far
approval.noCost: Values and the limit are at cost: they need cost access.
approval.rule: Over the limit (or with a value unknown) a person who counted none of the lines that differ approves; under it the apply approves.

valued.title: Valued inventory list
valued.kept: Stored with the count and kept for 10 years (art. 2220 c.c.).
valued.ready: Applied: sign it off to freeze the valued list.
valued.notYet: The valued list is made once every line is counted and the count is submitted.
valued.law: Values at cost: the lot's cost, else the standard cost (the accountant confirms the method).

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.draft: The draft is closed; nothing was counted.
cancel.started: The lines stay as history and free their stock for another count; nothing is posted.

approve.title: Approve {number}
approve.what_one: {count} line differs; its reason is given.
approve.what_other: {count} lines differ; each says its reason.
approve.unvalued_one: {count} line has no cost: its value is unknown.
approve.unvalued_other: {count} lines have no cost: their value is unknown.
approve.next: Then apply the differences: one COUNT move per line.

sendBack.title: Send {number} back
sendBack.what: The count goes back to counting with your reason; the counters count again.
sendBack.recount_one: Ask a recount of the {count} line flagged
sendBack.recount_other: Ask a recount of the {count} lines flagged

reason.noteNeeded: This reason asks for a short detail.

apply.what_one: {count} COUNT move is posted, dated {date} (the snapshot): stock goes in for more, out for less.
apply.what_other: {count} COUNT moves are posted, dated {date} (the snapshot): stock goes in for more, out for less.
apply.underLimit: Under the approval limit: applying also approves it.
apply.reversal: Reverse each move in Movements: an applied count is not undone as a whole.

signOff.title: Year-end sign-off
signOff.what: The year-end inventory as of {date} is signed off.
signOff.freezes: Its valued list (quantities and values at cost, per material, colour and lot) is frozen.
signOff.files: A PDF and an XLSX are stored with the count and kept for 10 years.

found.title: Found stock
found.what: Something found that the snapshot did not expect here: it becomes a line of its own (expected 0).

held.hide: A hide is found one by one: pick its lot and the hide.

problem.incomplete: Fill in the location, the material and a quantity above 0.

done.started: Counting started: the expected quantities are frozen.
done.approved: Approved: the differences can be applied.
done.signedOff: Inventory {number} signed off: its valued list is frozen.
done.found: The found stock is a line of the count.

problem.TOO_EARLY: A year-end inventory starts on its inventory date or after it.
problem.TOO_MANY_LINES: The scope holds too many stock keys for one count: count a location, a material or a kind at a time.
problem.HELD_BY_OTHER_COUNT: Some of this stock is being counted by {counts}: finish or cancel that count first, or narrow the scope.
problem.UNCOUNTED: Some lines are not counted yet: type 0 for what was not found.
problem.RECOUNT_DUE: Some recounts asked for are not done yet.
problem.NO_REASON: Some lines that differ have no reason: give one on Differences.
problem.OWN_VARIANCE: You counted or recounted lines that differ: another person approves them.
problem.ALREADY_COUNTED: That stock is a line of this count already: type its count there.
problem.SNAPSHOT_LINE: A line of the snapshot is not removed: type 0 for what was not found.
problem.NOT_APPROVED: The differences wait for their approval.
problem.NOT_EDITABLE: Only a draft or a count that is counting changes its team or note.
problem.NOT_COUNTING: The count is not counting any more: read it again.
problem.NOT_SUBMITTED: The count is not submitted: read it again.
problem.NOT_DRAFT: The count is started already: read it again.
problem.NOT_CANCELLABLE: Its differences are posted: reverse a move in Movements instead.
problem.SIGNED_OFF: Signed off already: its valued list is frozen.
problem.NOT_APPLIED: It is signed off once its differences are applied.
problem.NOT_YEAR_END: Only a year-end inventory has a valued list and a sign-off.
problem.NOT_STARTED: Its sheets are printed once it is started.
problem.CANCELLED: A cancelled count has no sheets.
problem.inventoryDate: The year-end inventory is taken as of 31 December.
problem.quantity: That quantity was not accepted (from 0, at most 4 decimals; a hide no more than its area).
problem.reason: That reason is not in the adjustment reasons any more: pick another.
